name: Tarnished Sword
description:
A dirty and dark-bladed sword.
It might've had some magical properties at some point, but definitely doesn't now.

name: Greyed Sword
description:
A darkened blade finally makes its appearance!
Imbued with \element[9].

name: Dark Slash
description:
When forging swords with Noire, apparently they become rather sinister-looking.
Imbued with \element[9], may slay causing \State[1](1%) on-hit.

name: Nocturnal Blade
description:
Further upgrading the quality of Noire is starting to make the blade look like midnight.
Imbued with \element[9], may slay causing \State[1](2%) on-hit.

name: Ecliptic Render
description:
The Noire has drunk so deeply that the blade now swallows what little light finds it.
Imbued with \element[9], may slay causing \State[1](3%) on-hit.

name: Lunar Vengeance
description:
The darkness in its most natural habitat, the dark side of the moon.
Imbued with \element[9], may slay causing \State[1](4%) on-hit.

name: "Light Thrust"
description:
⭐ An unusually glowy blade for a "sword in the stone" type of weapon.
Imbued with \element[8], may purge causing \State[1](2%) on-hit.

name: "Sacred Spine"
description:
⭐⭐ The glow of the blade appears to have sharpened the blade to a fine point.
Imbued with \element[8], may purge causing \State[1](4%) on-hit.

name: "Claidheamh Soluis"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended blade of pure energy, renowned for cleaving foes in twain.
Imbued with \element[8], may purge causing \State[1](6%) on-hit.

name: "The Corona"
description:
"Dark swallows the light; heaven opens, hell yawns wide;
and the crown remains."

name: Whistling Claymore
description:
It is very light- for a crappy claymore.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Gusty Slasher
description:
Forged with a nice chunk of verte, this sizeable slasher was born.
Imbued with \element[6], wielded in both hands.

name: Cyclone Sword
description:
The power of the gale wraps this massive sword like a soft and delicate blanket.
Imbued with \element[6], may apply \State[11](25%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: Mountaintop Chopper
description:
Empowered with the blessing of the mountain winds, you still aren't very fast while holding this.
Imbued with \element[6], may apply \State[11](50%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: Hurricane Hacker
description:
A mighty hurricane RAGES inside this vicious claymore, theoretically.
Imbued with \element[6], may apply \State[11](75%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: Sundering Cleaver
description:
An enormous claymore whose every slash cleaves the skies (and your foes defenses) asunder.
Imbued with \element[6], applies \State[11] on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Colossus"
description:
⭐ Are you trying to compensate by wielding this monstrously large chunk of rock?
Imbued with \element[7], may apply \State[12](50%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Juggernaut"
description:
⭐⭐ A colossal weapon reinforced with the finest ores.
Imbued with \element[7], applies \State[12] on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Lævateinn"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended blade of dragon-slaying might, able to take down any reptile around!
Imbued with \element[7], applies \State[12] on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Aeolian"
description:
The gale cannot be stopped, the mountain cannot be moved, and yet the canyon exists.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Rain Edge
description:
A blade that has taken on a much lighter form, and looks pretty slick now.
Imbued with "Liquid", may apply \State[10](10%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: Blaze Edge
description:
A blade that is too hot to touch! It seems forging with rouge has a heat-like elemental effect.
Imbued with "Heat", may apply \State[9](10%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: Vulcan Edge
description:
A ruthless blade powered by the flames of the finest Rouge.
Imbued with "Heat", may apply \State[9](20%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: Torrent Edge
description:
A gorgeous edge that is capable of a torrent of strikes in no time.
Imbued with "Liquid", may apply \State[10](20%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: Inferno Edge
description:
A blade whose edge never cools, forged from the most volatile rouge obtainable.
Imbued with "Heat", may apply \State[9](25%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: Maelstrom Edge
description:
A blade that moves like a current with a will of its own, pulling every strike into the next.
Imbued with "Liquid", may apply \State[10](25%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: "Agility"
description:
⭐ Supposedly the embodiment of agility, and does indeed improve hit and parry chances.
Designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: "Swiftness"
description:
⭐⭐ A masterfully refined upgrade to agility, this blade truly is swiftness incarnate.
Designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: "Hrunting"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended blade that drips with a lethal poison that will seal healing of any kind.
May apply \State[14](20%) on-hit, designed to be dual-wielded with another weapon.

name: "Gemini"
description:
Heat and current, quenched into one steel that promptly decided to be two.
Always found as a pair, and always wielded as one.

name: Poker
description:
While it is technically a spear-class weapon, this is still just a fucking stick.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Piercer
description:
Your standard-issue soldier's iron spear.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Perforator
description:
Punches clean holes through things that would rather remain whole.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Transfixer
description:
Long enough to go all the way through, and it usually does.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[15](5%) on-hit.

name: Eviscerator
description:
One twist of the shaft leaves a hole that will not close.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[15](10%) on-hit.

name: Bloodletter
description:
Its barbs are angled to open on the way out, not the way in.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[15](20%) on-hit.

name: "Akai Supeeya"
description:
⭐ It might be... from a foreign land... but it also might be a knock-off... At least it looks flashy?
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[15](25%) on-hit.

name: "Crimson Stabber"
description:
⭐⭐ The lethality of this blade is unmistakable. Blood everywhere.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[15](50%) on-hit.

name: "Rhongomyniad"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended spear that is makes you bleed just by looking at it.
Wielded in both hands, applies \State[15] on-hit.

name: "Ichor"
description:
They say that gods do not bleed; this went looking anyway.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Basher
description:
Though this is classified as a "spear", it is rather more a ball on a stick.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: Smasher
description:
We aren't getting any closer, but this absolutely will smash some skulls.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: Flasher
description:
A flashy and fabulously smashtastic weapon for bashing your foes.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: Clasher
description:
A deadly and dangerous "spear", far and beyond something to poke with, just shove it at them.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: Thrasher
description:
Whatever poking this could do was abandoned somewhere around the third swing.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: Crasher
description:
Still filed under "spear", and at this point that is purely a paperwork problem.
Wielded in both hands, may apply \State[8](5%) on-hit.

name: "Concussivity"
description:
⭐ At this point, we aren't even trying to hide the lack of spear-ness.
Imbued with "Ground", may apply \State[12](25%) and \State[8](5%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Ground Pounder"
description:
⭐⭐ A massive hammer designed for crushing skulls- exactly as you aim to do.
Imbued with "Ground", may apply \State[12](50%) on-hit and \State[8](10%) on-hit, wielded in both hands.

name: "Daedalus"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended smashing tool, crafted by a legendary smith of unparalleled skill.
Imbued with "Ground", applies \State[12] and maybe \State[8](15%) on-hit, wielded in both hands, destroys shielded foes.

name: "Seismos"
description:
The ground does not break where it is struck; it breaks everywhere else.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Floppy Dart
description: The shaft has more give in it than anyone would like, but it still lands point-first. Usually.

name: Whaling Harpoon
description: An excellent harpoon that was used in ancient times to puncture whale hide.

name: Kaboom Needle
description: While sharp spears are great, exploding spears are typically even greater.

name: Harisakeru
description: Exacerbating explosive spears leads to super deadly and explosive spears.

name: Pilum
description: Its shank is meant to bend on impact, so that pulling it back out is somebody else's problem.

name: Shrike
description: Named for the bird that leaves what it catches hanging on a thorn, still fresh.

name: "Fish Eater"
description: ⭐ Excellent at piercing any type of aquatic animal thanks to its razor sharp point.

name: "Sauroter"
description: ⭐⭐ The addition of serration enables slaying both aquatic and reptiles effortlessly.

name: "Vel"
description: ⭐⭐⭐ An ascended javelin said to pierce anything, including aquatics, reptiles, and deities.

name: "Stigmata"
description: Every hole it leaves stays open, and they all come due at once.

name: Zip Gun
description:
A pipe, a nail, and a rubber band. It fires about as well as that sounds,
which is to say it is a tier-1 weapon.

name: Beretta
description:
A standard everyday pistol.
Shoots bullets, in case you were unaware.

name: Magnum
description:
A magnum, the king of classic pistols.
Fires with a over-compensating BANG.

name: Deagle
description:
If two magnums had a baby, it'd be this.
Because it blows you into chunks with a single shot.

name: Zeliska
description:
Six kilograms of revolver, chambered for a round meant to stop an elephant.
Aiming it is optional. Surviving it is not.

name: KS Model 1337
description:
Thanks to advancements in technology,
your gun now looks as cool as it is lethal.

name: "Burning Bullet"
description:
⭐ A pistol that fires angry bullets to slay its foes.
Imbued with "Heat", has high crit.

name: "Hellfire Shot"
description:
⭐⭐ A raging pistol powered by your hatred.
Imbued with "Heat", has high crit.

name: "Xiuhcoatl"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended pistol that basically breathes flame bullets on your behalf.
Imbued with "Heat", has high crit.

name: "Verdict"
description:
Everything that came before it was argument.
This is only the part where it is settled.

name: 10-Volt Stun Gun
description:
A stun gun with a weak battery.
It is effectively a training weapon at this point.

name: Butthole Tingler
description: After replacing the battery, the stun gun is now a STUN GUN.

name: 10000-Volt Stun Gun
description: An extremely well-advertised and obviously good brand of battery powers this stun gun.

name: Teravolt Stun Gun
description: Packing a massive battery, you can release untold torrents of destruction on your foes.

name: Petavolt Stun Gun
description: The battery is not sold in stores, and the man who sold it to you seemed nervous about it.

name: Exavolt Stun Gun
description: Whatever is in the battery compartment is not, strictly speaking, a battery anymore.

name: "Fly Zapper"
description:
⭐ A bugzapper that had some DIY work to make it projectile-worthy.
Destroys insects.

name: "Defoliant"
description:
⭐⭐ If you continue to overcharge a bugzapper, it'll start destroying foliage, too.
Destroys insects and plants.

name: "Teen Baan"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ A stun gun with an ascended battery, capable of obliterating all of humanity.
Destroys insects, plants, and humanoids.

name: "Vitrification"
description: Nothing scatters and nothing burns. There is only a smooth place where something used to be.

name: Scattershot
description:
Your standard in shotguns. A bit heavy and rusty, but requires less effort.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Tribarrel
description:
A triple-barrel shotgun for firing three times at once.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Decabarrel
description:
A 10-barrel shotgun for firing ten times at once.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Centibarrel
description:
A 100-barrel shotgun for firing ...not 100 times at once, but it does hit a lot!
Wielded in both hands.

name: Kilobarrel
description:
A 1000-barrel shotgun. Nobody has counted them, and nobody is going to.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Megabarrel
description:
A million barrels, allegedly. The paperwork burned up along with everything else.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Blaster"
description:
⭐ A unique-shaped gun for blasting holes through bitches.
Destroys undead.

name: "Spray of Death"
description:
⭐⭐ A ruthless shotgun for dealing with your average zombie apocalypse.
Destroys undead.

name: "Astra"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ A shotgun with ascended barrels for obliterating even beezlebub in one shot.
Banishes undead.

name: "Legion"
description:
Ask it what it is called, and every barrel answers.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Kindling Hatchet
description:
An axe sized for splitting kindling and absolutely nothing else.
It has never met anything that fought back.

name: Wolftrap Maul
description:
A beginner's maul designed for easing woodchopping, but laced with wolftrap sap.
May apply \State[16](20%).

name: Beartrap Hewer
description:
A hewing axe glazed with resin bled from a beartrap.
May apply \State[16](40%).

name: Orctrap Cleaver
description:
A heavy cleaver capable of doing some serious damage, laced with orctrap venom.
May apply \State[16](60%).

name: Wyrmtrap Maul
description:
A wicked axe with a tremendous heft to it, laced with the bile of a wyrmtrap.
May apply \State[16](80%).

name: Deathtrap Broadaxe
description:
An axe glazed entirely with the most lethal venom in the galaxy: the Deathtrap.
Applies \State[16].

name: "Glowing Hacker"
description:
⭐ A small glowing axe, which feels static to the touch.
Destroys constructs.

name: "Sky Splitter"
description:
⭐⭐ A dangerously charged and long axe that cleaves the skies.
Destroys constructs.

name: "Mjolnir"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended axe- I mean chainsaw- capable of rending all asunder.
Destroys constructs.

name: "Reckoning"
description:
Every blow you walked away from was being counted.
Nothing walks away from this one.

name: Leaden Poleaxe
description:
So dense it fights you on the backswing. Every hit lands late and lands anyway.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Bulky Sagaris
description:
A Scythian pattern rendered in far too much iron. Shorter recovery, marginally.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Balanced Battleaxe
description:
The point where the axe stops arguing. Head and haft finally agree on where to go.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Nimble Labrys
description:
Twin heads, and somehow lighter than the one before it. The arc closes noticeably faster.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Featherweight Bardiche
description:
A polearm you can hold at arm's length one-handed, if only to prove it.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Gossamer Halberd
description:
You can see the far wall through the blade. It comes back around before you finish swinging it.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Crescent Blossom"
description:
⭐ A crescent of an axe, opening an arc barely wider than your reach.
Destroys humanoids, wielded in both hands.

name: "Half-Moon Bloom"
description:
⭐⭐ The arc widens past half a circle, and nothing inside it gets a say.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Ecliptic Efflorescence"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ The swing closes on itself. Everything within the arc is simply gone.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "The Styrofoam Axe"
description:
Weighs nothing. Has never chipped, never bent, and has never once failed
to go all the way through. Wielded in both hands.

name: Khopesh
description:
A bronze sickle-sword whose hook exists to drag a shield out of the way.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Shotel
description:
Curved so far past sense that it reaches around a shield to the man behind it.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Falx
description:
It came over the shield rim so hard that an empire redesigned its helmets.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Rhomphaia
description:
The falx given a longer shaft, so the reach arrives well before the answer does.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Tepoztopilli
description:
Rows of volcanic glass set along a shaft, every edge only a few atoms wide.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Urumi
description:
Several flexible razors that do not go through a guard so much as around it.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Plate Peeler"
description:
⭐ It gets under the edge of whatever you are wearing, and then it lifts.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Bared Truth"
description:
⭐⭐ By the third swing there is nothing at all left between you and it.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Fragarach"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ The Answerer. It cuts any shield, any wall, and any story you told about either.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Ablation"
description:
Nothing here is defeated. It is removed, one layer at a time, until there is no next layer.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Aged Crook
description: A plain (but probably slightly magical) wooden staff.

name: Oak Staff
description:
A well-made oaken staff, a proper accompaniment to any aspiring mage.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Mage Staff
description:
An oaken staff adorned with dreamcatcher-like mesh.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Ancient Crook
description:
Compressing the sheer magical energies of ages past result in potent magics today.
Wielded in both hands.

name: Bedazzled Staff
description:
An ancient relic of the shaman's of past. The kawaii ones, obviously.
Wielded in both hands.

name: "Flame's Mind"
description:
⭐ A glowing ember, representing magical things.
Imbued with "Heat", may apply \State[9](25%), wielded in both hands.

name: "Shaman's Will"
description:
⭐⭐ The will of the flame shaman howls silently inside this staff.
Imbued with "Heat", may apply \State[9](50%), wielded in both hands.

name: "Ruyi"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended staff embodying the carnal desires of the flame.
Wielded in both hands, applies \State[9],

name: Blue Wand
description:
A cute wand bearing a couple of dangling kappa scales for extra magical oomph.
Deconstructs slimes.

name: Sapphire Rod
description:
An ornate rod adorned with sapphires to amplify its magical properties.
Deconstructs slimes.

name: Tracing Wand
description:
An extremely light wand designed to trace arcane sigils in the air.
Deconstructs slimes.

name: Stardust Rod
description:
Adorned with the power of the stars, this wand knows no bounds.
Deconstructs slimes.

name: "Wet Dream"
description:
⭐ It looks like a large stalagmite, but it is translucent and radiating magical energies.
Imbued with "Liquid", may apply \State[10](25%) on-hit.

name: "Azure Depths"
description:
⭐⭐ Further empowered with crystalline power, the depths are endless.
Imbued with "Liquid", may apply \State[10](50%) on-hit.

name: "Was"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended rod of mythic proportions, said to control all liquid universally.
Imbued with "Liquid", applies \State[10] on-hit.

name: Old Tome
description:
An aging tome with words barely legible.
Probably contains some degree of magic.

name: Book of Beasts
description:
A book with binding made from all the furs of the monsters it has defeated.
Slays beasts.

name: Primal Codex
description:
A vast codex of unending knowledge about beasts and their deepest secrets.
Slays beasts.

name: Surreal Opus
description:
The final works of one of the grandest archmages to ever live, \_ever\_.
Slays beasts.

name: "Tonguetwister"
description:
⭐ An old tome probably found in the restricted section of the library.
Imbued with "Void", may apply \State[14](25%).

name: "Secret Archive"
description:
⭐⭐ An ancient tome full of diabolical secrets.
Imbued with "Void", may apply \State[14](50%).

name: "Rauðskinna"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended tome with the ancient sigils describing how to control the gods.
Imbued with "Void", applies \State[14], defeats deities.

name: Worn Glove
description:
A glove that has seen many an action.
What that action was remains a mystery, so just wear it.

name: Leather Fists
description: You only punch with one hand, so just put them both on the same hand for extra power!

name: Studded Hands
description:
Mighty hands studded with rocks and shit.
Imbued with "Ground", smooshes bugs.

name: Granite Gloves
description:
Fists made of pure granite, meaning they are unbearably heavy.
Imbued with "Ground", smooshes bugs.

name: Terra Fists
description:
Fists that radiate ground energy, possibly related to \N[3].
Imbued with "Ground", smooshes bugs.

name: "Royal Fist"
description:
⭐ The royal fists of an ancient probably important but not to you bloodline.
Obliterates shielded foes.

name: "Supreme Metacarpus"
description:
⭐⭐ The might of the supreme reign true, enabling even crossdimensional foes to fall to your might.
Obliterates shielded and aurific foes.

name: "Hecatoncheire"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended fist that can pummel even crossdimensional beings to dust.
Obliterates shielded foes, aural foes, and deities.

name: Metal Claws
description:
Sometimes it is more efficient to cut rather than beat things to death.
Ignores 10% of parry.

name: Cat Claws
description:
Sometimes just beating them senseless doesn't work.
Ignores 20% of parry, slays beasts.

name: Eagle Talons
description:
Sharp claws like the talons of an eagle, your slashes can penetrate the most durable hides.
Ignores 30% of parry, annihilates flying foes.

name: Dragon Claws
description:
The literal claws of a dragon, ripped out and used to intimidate prey.
Ignores 40% of parry, decimates reptiles.

name: "Bladed Mitts"
description:
⭐ A pair of soft mitts that are rather comfortable but with razor sharp blades.
Ignores 33% of parry.

name: "Whetted Hands"
description:
⭐⭐ Each of the 40 blades on this claw were precision-sharpened with a whetstone.
Ignores 66% of parry.

name: "Death Knell"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended set of claws for tearing through reality like paper.
Cannot be parried.

name: Basic Arm
description:
A light mechanical enhancement for your arm used to tear apart robots.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](5%).

name: Heavy Arm
description:
A rather heavy but effective arm for knocking foes around.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](15%).

name: Cruel Support
description:
Use this cruel arm enhancement to crush your foes without mercy or remorse.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](20%).

name: Defense Buster
description:
A ruthless arm extension for demolishing constructs.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](25%).

name: "Meta Arm"
description:
⭐ A cybernetic wonder, with some tutorials on kicking machine ass.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](20%).

name: "Sybirtek Arm"
description:
⭐⭐ A mechanical masterpiece, constructed by Sybirtek™ for your combat pleasure.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](30%).

name: "Járngreipr"
description:
⭐⭐⭐ An ascended mechano-arm programmed with self-healing knowledge and mechanical destruction.
Disassembles constructs, may apply \State[8](40%).
